name: The Lady Knight and The Three Princes
source:
In a faraway land there's three princes waiting for marriage candidates.

Anyone is welcome, as long as they can complete a specific task - each prince has a unique one.

No one has succeeded... yet.

You are a lady knight, and with a loyal bear by your side and an axe on your belt, you might just do it.

[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/the-lady-knight]itch.io[/url]]
